says: The castle tower is gone. The lookout is now an organic gourd of a building: a bulging body with a smaller pod bolted to its flank with a porthole, a curved balcony with a rail round its neck, pipes running down one side, louvred vents on the belly, a low oval door, a soft dome stippled on its shadow side, and a slim antenna with a dish. Each small island has its own silhouette now: a tilted slab, a stub carrying one twisted tree, a fragment of ruin with broken columns, and two pebbles far off. The stray lines are replaced by a low bank of cloud far below, layered broken scallops with stipple settling under them.
